description: Layer 1 (Basic) deep-dive fixes: Security fundamentals, remaining config issues, and basic correctness fixes for P1 warnings that are simple to implement.
steps: SEC-W1: In apps/backend/app/core/security.py, fix the is_safe_url() function to use async DNS resolution. Replace socket.getaddrinfo() with asyncio-compatible resolution. Since the function is called synchronously, wrap it in run_in_executor or change the function signature to async and update callers.

SEC-W3: In apps/edge/src/middleware/cors.ts, fix the hardcoded origin. Make the corsHeaders export accept an origin parameter or remove the hardcoded export entirely, using env.ALLOWED_ORIGIN dynamically wherever cors headers are needed.

SEC-W4: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py, strengthen password validation. Add checks for at least one uppercase, one lowercase, one digit. Update both the SignupRequest and ResetPasswordRequest validators.

SEC-W5: Add a /logout endpoint in apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py that accepts the current access token and refresh token, stores their jti (or hash) in Redis with TTL matching their remaining expiry, effectively blacklisting them.

SEC-W6: In apps/backend/app/main.py, add a Content-Security-Policy header in the security headers middleware. Use a policy appropriate for an SPA: default-src 'self'; script-src 'self'; style-src 'self' 'unsafe-inline'; img-src 'self' data: https:; font-src 'self' https://fonts.gstatic.com; connect-src 'self' https://*.syrabit.ai;

SEC-W7: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py google_auth endpoint, check supabase_user.get('email_verified') before accepting the identity. If not verified, return HTTP 400 'Email not verified by OAuth provider'.

SEC-R3: In apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py, add an early guard at the start of handle_razorpay_webhook: if not settings.RAZORPAY_WEBHOOK_SECRET: raise HTTPException(503, 'Webhook not configured'). Place this before the HMAC calculation.

API-W3: In apps/backend/app/api/v1/users.py, add cascade deletion of ChatFeedback when deleting account. After the Chat deletion, add: from app.models.feedback import ChatFeedback; await ChatFeedback.find({'user_id': str(user.id)}).delete().

AUTH-C1: Replace all datetime.utcnow() usages with datetime.now(timezone.utc) in: apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py (lines 68, 73, 78, and in reset_password handler), apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py (calculate_next_billing_date). Add 'from datetime import timezone' import where missing.

DEPLOY-W3: In apps/backend/app/config.py validate_production_secrets method, add warnings for missing AI provider credentials (VERTEX_PROJECT_ID, SARVAM_API_KEY), payment credentials (RAZORPAY_KEY_ID), and email credentials (RESEND_API_KEY) in production.
acceptance_criteria: Password validation requires mixed character types (uppercase, lowercase, digit)
A /logout endpoint exists that blacklists tokens in Redis
Content-Security-Policy header is present in all responses
Razorpay webhook returns 503 if secret is not configured
datetime.utcnow() replaced with datetime.now(timezone.utc) in all auth and webhook files
Production config validation warns about missing AI/payment/email credentials
verification: Run: python -c "import ast; [ast.parse(open(f).read()) for f in ['apps/backend/app/config.py', 'apps/backend/app/main.py', 'apps/backend/app/api/v1/auth.py', 'apps/backend/app/api/v1/users.py', 'apps/backend/app/api/webhooks/razorpay.py', 'apps/backend/app/core/security.py']]; print('OK')"
